description: Replication Data for: Thermo-Fluid Performance Optimization of Refrigerated Cold-Chain Systems Using an AI-Enabled Digital Twin Framework is published by Atthar , Syed Eirfan. The replication package combines telemetry, fault logs and MATLAB/Simulink models with a random-forest thermal-demand predictor. Its stated coverage is Study-specific mobile refrigerated logistics under tropical thermal stress. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC0-1.0. The deposit supports a submitted manuscript; reproducibility and claimed telemetry provenance were not independently checked. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
